The DRAFT explicitly concedes the MDE regularity certificate is numerical (8x8 fixed-point iteration over eta 4e-3..2.5e-4, finite-eta slope ~0.093, finite-eta stability spectra) with no interval-arithmetic enclosure, so uniform invertibility and positive eta-to-0 limit at the unknown e* are not proved. This is experimental evidence, not proof.
